mentions.name: DriftE
mentions.description: DriftE is an in-depth cloud discovery platform that detects and fixes unmanaged "ghost" resources, configuration differences, and manual cloud changes to enforce infrastructure-as-code.
mentions.problem: Cloud environments accumulate unmanaged "ghost" resources, configuration differences, and manual changes that drift from declared infrastructure-as-code.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just launched DriftE — it's a in-depth Cloud discovery platform that fixes unmanaged "ghost" resources, configuration differences and manual cloud changes for enforcing your IaC.
